blocks.source: Vol IV, Policy Training, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: The mathematical foundations of modern policy optimization originate in classical dynamic programming. @bellman1957dynamic introduced the principle of optimality and the recursive decomposition that defines value functions, while @howard1960dynamic formulated policy iteration to solve discrete Markov decision processes. Parallel to dynamic programming, learning from demonstration developed along an empirical path in robotics. Pomerleau's ALVINN demonstrated early autonomous road following by training a shallow artificial neural network to map camera images directly to steering angles. ALVINN quickly exposed the vulnerability of pure behavioral cloning to covariate shift and compounding error.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A policy's weights keep what its experience rewarded but not which experience it was, so each regime (demonstrations, logged rewards, simulation, trial on the machine, a pretrained base) leaves a characteristic dependency no training score shows.
A simulator's contact model decides what the optimizer learns, and a soft penalty spring lets a policy pass through contacts the real plate would resist.
On-machine fine-tuning absorbs a measurable local mismatch but produces new weights whose earlier evaluations no longer apply, and a gated residual bounds where adaptation may act.

The policy manifest records how a checkpoint was produced (regime sequence, base digest, inference contract, data support, omission log, wear log) and computes the declared ODD as support minus omissions.
